# Billy's Barbershop — Full Profile

> Hillcrest's premier barbershop in San Diego, California. Rated 5.0 stars across 307 verified reviews on Booksy. Specializing in master fades, skin fades, tapers, beard work, hot towel shaves, line-ups, comb overs, and straight razor work. Signature experience: Cut · Razor · Wash · Style from $40.

## Services and pricing
- Regular Haircut — $40 (30 min): precision cut tailored to your style.
- Premium Haircut — $50 (45 min): detailed cut, hot towel, wash, and styling.
- Beard Trim — $30 (30 min): shaped, lined, and conditioned.
- Hot Towel Shave — $50 (45 min): classic straight-razor shave with hot towels.
- Basic Facial — $45 (45 min): cleanse, exfoliate, and refresh.
- Eyebrow Thread — $15 (15 min); Eyebrow Wax — $20 (25 min).
- Hair Color — varies (60 min).
- Signature: Cut · Razor · Wash · Style from $40.
